keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «릴리가 밀가루를 쏟는다(실수)» 와 «작은 실수는 괜찮다는 것을 배운다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the mistake (Lily spills flour) and the lesson (small mistakes are okay). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why is the kitchen white and messy?
opts: Lily spills flour on the floor.
evs: Oops! She spills flour on the floor.
On Sunday, Lily and Dad make pancakes.
The pancakes taste great, and Lily learns that small mistakes are okay.
why: «Oops! She spills flour on the floor.» 릴리가 하얀 밀가루를 바닥에 쏟아서 부엌이 하얗고 지저분해졌어요.
Lily spills white flour on the floor, so the kitchen is white and messy.

qs.q: Dad says, "That's okay!" What does he mean?
qs.qko: 아빠가 «That's okay!» 라고 말해요. 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: The mess is not a big problem.
evs: They clean up together and cook the pancakes.
Lily mixes the eggs, milk, and flour.
Oops! She spills flour on the floor.
On Sunday, Lily and Dad make pancakes.
why: «They clean up together and cook the pancakes.» 화내지 않고 함께 치우고 계속 요리했으니, 큰 문제가 아니라는 뜻이에요.
They clean up together and keep cooking, so the mess is not a big problem.

qs.q: How does Lily learn that small mistakes are okay?
qs.qko: 릴리는 어떻게 작은 실수는 괜찮다는 것을 배우나요?
opts: Dad says it is okay, and they clean up together.
evs: They clean up together and cook the pancakes.
On Sunday, Lily and Dad make pancakes.
Lily mixes the eggs, milk, and flour.
why: 아빠가 «괜찮아!» 라고 말하고(«Dad laughs and says...»), 둘이 함께 치웠어요(«They clean up together...»).
Dad says, "That's okay!" and they clean up together.

ends: Lily and Dad make a birthday cake for Mom.
릴리와 아빠는 엄마를 위해 생일 케이크를 만든다.
Lily makes pancakes for her friends.

write.src: “I can’t <u>cook alone</u>, but I can <u>mix the eggs</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «못 하는 일 + 대신 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write something you can’t do and something you can do in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «but I can» 뒤에 «누구와 함께» 를 붙여 써 보세요. (예: but I can cook with Dad)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «but I can», add who you do it with. (e.g. but I can cook with Dad)
